name: la-souris/credit-check-sdk
description: Provider-agnostic credit-check SDK for PHP: model applicants and their affordability profile as typed value objects, submit a check through any CreditChecker implementation (EDR/EDR, or your own) and read back a normalised decision.

suggest.la-souris/credit-check-edr: Required to run credit checks through the EDR (EDR Group) API.
suggest.la-souris/credit-check-laravel: Laravel integration (service provider, driver manager, facade).
